subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw add a non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup path, and what secret-bearing handoff format is acceptable?
rationale: This adds provider-auth and likely env/CLI surface around OAuth authorization material; the safe contract depends on maintainer security and product intent, not just implementation mechanics.

options.title: Design Safer Auth Handoff
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved OpenAI-plugin handoff that validates PKCE/state, minimizes raw callback URL exposure, documents redaction behavior, and tests logs/shell/CI handling.

options.title: Accept Callback URL Env
options.body: Support a callback URL environment import only with explicit validation, redaction, docs, and proof for common leak paths.

options.title: Defer To Existing Flows
options.body: Keep API-key, browser/manual paste, device-code, and existing Codex token paths as the supported setup surfaces for now.

recommendation.title: Design Safer Auth Handoff
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved OpenAI-plugin handoff that validates PKCE/state, minimizes raw callback URL exposure, documents redaction behavior, and tests logs/shell/CI handling.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent history ties this account most strongly to OpenAI provider identity, provider setup, and non-interactive auth helper work.
